paragraphs.text: The Codex Vocifera , commonly called Codie , is an animated codex associated with the Biblioplex of Strixhaven University on Arcavios .

The Codex Vocifera is an ancient tome filled with complex and arcane mystical knowledge that has, over centuries, developed a form of self-awareness. It is made from arcanotext printed in reactive synchronistic ink within a noulum binder. It roams the halls of the university on its creaky metal legs in a perpetual state of annoyance, frequently reading passages from its pages aloud. Should it notice someone showing interest in its contents, the Codex will relentlessly follow that person for hours, often causing considerable frustration. The Codex strongly dislikes its student-bestowed nickname, "Codie," but ironically, its vocal objections only ensured the name stuck.

Sometime between 91 and 249:2 MA (between c. 3952 and 4110 AR ), Lorehold and Silverquill scholars speculated that, under the proper conditions, a tome could serve as a vessel for its own animative spellcasting. Professors Squipp, Malchendoon, and Borenlond furthered the theory.

The Codex Vocifera was authored by Zarida Mincely between 91 and 249:2 MA. Codie is logged as book No. 24991 in the Strixhaven Biblioplex . Over the following three centuries, it was checked out by at least 8 students and transported through time before self-actualizing sometime after 557:8 MA ( c. 4418 AR). There are differing theories about the origin of the Codex's sentience. Some suggest it is the unintended outcome of a Lorehold ritual involving spirit summoning that went awry, while others consider it nothing more than a cosmic prank.

Codie played a key role in informing Zimone Wola about the fate of her grandmother, Nimiroti Wola . It later assisted an alternate Ral Zarek in locating a Blood Age tome stored in the Vaults of Turrau.

An alternate version of Codie exists in Hexhaven in the Echoverse . It is described as a menacing sentient tome that contains dangerous, arcane knowledge from across the Echoverse. The Theorist has restricted access to it to ensure that no individual with ill intent can gain access to its powerful magic. Locks and magical hexes keep the tome bound, but after gaining sentience from the mind-magic that pervades the halls of Hexhaven, Codie is a malevolence eager to escape.
Codie appears in the trailer for Strixhaven: School of Mages . In Secrets of Strixhaven , his original card was errata 'd by adding the Book artifact type.
